versions.localizedDescription:
# 🚀 Nuvio Enhanced iOS v0.4.16

- Full iOS Edge-Swipe Back Gesture support across all secondary pages, settings subpages, detail screens, stream views, catalogs, and collections
- Interactive drag physics with spring dismissal and backdrop scrim fade
- Left-edge depth shadow cues and haptic feedback on dismissal threshold
- Liquid Glass floating navigation bar stability enhancements
